It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.body: The company makes less than US$5m in revenue. Total revenue: ₹464m (US$5.0m) This is considered a minor risk. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected.
